brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.evidence: Build has only level 0 pieces (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,1,0;full). No pieces at level 1 or 2. check_build shows meshClash clear but LOOSE_BODY warning, not a tower.

No drawer parts present (counts: piece:4 only). Bottom storey currently uses full bases, which do not offer drawer sockets; drawer requires half-base cut face or notch frame between two bases. Not implemented.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey
requirements.evidence: No bins present in build. Top storey (level 2) does not exist, so no bins placed on top. find_sockets offers bins at level 0 but none installed.

finish.summary: Build is only a single-storey 2x2 flat of full hex bases at level 0 with no vertical stacking. Mesh is clear but tower height, bottom-storey drawers, and top-storey open bins all remain unbuilt as no time to reconfigure to half-bases/notches and stacked storeys.
